model: Thermokon Thanos room operating unit via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Thermokon Thanos touch room operating units with Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Thermokon Thanos: 590 objects (72 AI, 456 AO, 62 BO), 192 polled by default. Most of the map is configuration: display, illumination, set point ranges and labels, fan stages, occupancy and two controller blocks (parameters, limits, fan coil interaction). Live values - internal temperature and humidity, effective set points, fan stage, occupancy, key states and controller outputs - are inputs and are unpolled by default.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Thermokon_Thanos_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the Thanos Modbus register list (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/Thermokon_Thanos_a_LX.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 192 of the 590 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.

integration.summary: Tick the live values (temperature, humidity, effective set point, fan stage, occupancy, controller outputs) before mapping; the polled defaults are mostly controller 1 and 2 parameters.

minimum_points.name: Set point effective 1 (Default set point + set point offset)

setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: The polled defaults are configuration outputs; writing them changes the device setup.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
